commit.message:
fix(security): [develop] harden user settings validation, Guest writes, and realtime graph access (#9015)

* Harden user settings validation, Guest write restrictions, and realtime graph access

Validate user preference values against $settings_user field schemas in
auth_profile.php and save_user_settings(), enforce POST on profile save
and update_data actions, and reject Guest account mutations across
profile, 2FA, and realtime endpoints.

Validate tree pagination and numeric user settings before SQL LIMIT and
JavaScript output in lib/html_tree.php.

Enforce is_graph_allowed() before realtime poller execution and cache
reads in graph_realtime.php, anchor the graph_nolegend regex, and clamp
realtime intervals before shell execution.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* test(security): add changed-line coverage fixture and use existing i18n messages

Use existing 'Permission Denied' message in auth_profile.php and raw
'GRAPH ACCESS DENIED' token in graph_realtime.php so locales/po/cacti.pot
stays in sync without template churn.

Minimize indentation churn in auth_profile.php and graph_realtime.php,
load user_setting_validation.php via CACTI_PATH_LIBRARY in
save_user_settings(), and add UserSettingsAndRealtimeHardening fixture
coverage probes for PR changed-code coverage gates.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

commit.message:
fix(i18n): [develop] fix gettext runtime, RTL direction, JS string encoding, and catalog defects (#8991)

* fix(i18n): [develop] fix positional printf, %% escaping, number_format_i18n, and RRD LANG handling

Allow positional format specifiers (%1$s, %2$d, %1$.2f) in __() and __x() so translated strings using reordered arguments pass through sprintf().

Preserve %% in __gettext() until after sprintf() runs in __() and __x(), and guard __x() so messages without conversion specifiers do not fail on literal % under PHP 8.

In number_format_i18n(), normalize ICU locale keys instead of duplicating the country code, apply $baseu K/M/G/T scaling consistently in the ext-intl path, query setlocale(LC_ALL, '0'), and restore LC_ALL using the string category name under PHP 8.

Fix the $path2msfiler typo, check $config['i18n_text_log'] in i18n_text_debug(), add get_locale_direction(), and update rrdtool_set_language()/rrdtool_reset_language() to use C.UTF-8 with LC_NUMERIC=C and unset LANG/LC_NUMERIC when previously unset.

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* fix(i18n): [develop] encode translated JavaScript string literals with json_encode

Emit translated strings embedded in inline JavaScript blocks via json_encode() so apostrophes and quotes in translations cannot break script parsing, and avoid literal HTML entities in plain JS string contexts.

Refs #8555, #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* fix(i18n): [develop] repair shipped PO catalog defects and recompile all MO binaries

Repair mechanical defects across the 24 shipped catalogs and recompile all 24 stale .mo binaries:
- Fix inverted hi-IN.po Plural-Forms (plural=n > 1;)
- Repair he-IL.po double-UTF-8 mojibake on 'No Device'
- Replace stale php-format flags with no-php-format on the two '80% of' memory_limit entries, clearing all 17 msgfmt fatal errors
- Fix broken % d / % s format specifiers, stale msgstr placeholders, HTML tag count/name/balance defects, stray Unicode bidi overrides, spaced |variable| tokens, and baked-in HTML entities absent from msgid
- Recompile all 24 locales/LC_MESSAGES/*.mo binaries to match locales/po/*.po (including ka-GE.mo)

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* test(i18n): [develop] add runtime, RTL, and JS encoding regression tests and changelog fragment

Add Pest unit tests covering positional printf specifiers, %% preservation before sprintf(), __x() literal percent safety, number_format_i18n() ICU locale normalization/scaling/LC_NUMERIC preservation, i18n_text_debug(), get_locale_direction(), rrdtool_set_language()/rrdtool_reset_language(), api_scheduler_javascript(), RTL header wiring, and newly encoded inline JS strings.

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* ci(i18n): [develop] support --base incremental filtering in run_msgcheck.py

Add --base <ref> filtering to tests/tools/run_msgcheck.py so i18n-validation.yml audits only PO entries added or modified in the PR (matching audit_po.py --base) instead of failing on pre-existing fuzzy or punctuation entries elsewhere in a catalog.

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* Fix changed-PHP coverage runner fallback and unused regex in run_msgcheck

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* Guard overlong locale in number_format_i18n fallback and cover localeconv path

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

commit.message:
fix(i18n): [develop] quote translated labels selected as SQL literals (#8990)

* fix(i18n): quote translated labels selected as SQL literals

Several drop_sql and tree queries splice a translation between hand
written quotes. A translation containing the quote character closes the
literal early. The shipped fr-FR catalog already does this: 'Any' is
"N'importe lequel", so the Device Template dropdown on the report item
edit page becomes

    SELECT -1 AS id, 'N'importe lequel' AS name UNION ...

which is a syntax error, and the dropdown is empty for French users.

Quote every translated label in these queries with db_qstr(), as
support.php already does for its task names:

- lib/html_reports.php: Any / None in the site and device template
  report item filters
- lib/auth.php: the Branch: / Device: prefixes in get_allowed_branches()
- include/global_form.php: External in the data source profile list
- support.php: Name: / Procs: / Threads: in the technical summary

msgids are unchanged, so cacti.pot does not change. The SQL
interpolation audit drops support.php from 3 to 1 value sites; its
baseline is left for the automated refresh.

Signed-off-by: Andre Devay <andretorresdg@alumni.usp.br>

* Add changelog entry

Signed-off-by: Andre Devay <andretorresdg@alumni.usp.br>

---------

Signed-off-by: Andre Devay <andretorresdg@alumni.usp.br>

commit.message: fix(i18n): [develop] escape translations printed into single-quoted attributes (#8989) * fix(i18n): escape translations printed into single-quoted attributes A raw __() printed into a single-quoted HTML attribute ends the attribute at the first apostrophe in the translation. Two of these are already broken by the shipped catalogs: - utilities.php: fr-FR renders data-defaultLabel='Intervalle d'actualisation', so the refresh filter label is cut to "Intervalle d" - data_queries.php: it-IT renders title='Aggiungi il nome dell'origine dei dati Nome suggerito' Use __esc() for every translation printed into a single-quoted attribute, as the neighbouring value='' attributes already do. This covers 19 sites in eight files; msgids are unchanged, so cacti.pot does not change. feat(i18n): [develop] add 15 African locales and compiled catalogs (#8950) (#8954)

Add complete PO/MO translation catalogs, get_list_of_locales() registrations, and unit tests for 15 African locales (af-ZA, am-ET, ar-EG, ar-MA, fr-MA, fr-SN, ha-NG, ig-NG, mg-MG, rw-RW, so-SO, sw-KE, xh-ZA, yo-NG, zu-ZA).

All 15 catalogs match locales/po/cacti.pot (6,133 entries each) with 0 fuzzy entries, 0 untranslated entries, positional placeholders on multi-variable strings, msgcheck end-punctuation parity, and clean msgfmt --check --check-format --check-header verification.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>
